why: Speculative decoding's speed follows how predictable the text is, so it is measured on natural requests, not token ids. A repetitive synthetic prompt once ranked k=3 above k=2 on the 27B AWQ (95 against 87 tok/s) where natural prompts ranked it below (81.6 against 88.6), docs/recommended-setup.md. Each prompt is sent as one user turn through the model's own chat template. Change the set only with a new version: measurements name the version and the set's sha256.

prompts.text: Explain how TCP congestion control works, from slow start to fast recovery, and why it matters on a congested network.
Write a Python function that merges overlapping intervals in a list, with a short explanation and a few unit tests.
Summarize the main causes of the First World War and how they interacted in the summer of 1914.
Write a short story about a lighthouse keeper who receives a letter that was posted forty years ago.
Compare relational and document databases for a small online store: data model, consistency, scaling and cost.
Derive the quadratic formula step by step from the general quadratic equation, explaining each step.
Give clear step-by-step instructions for baking a simple loaf of bread at home, including what can go wrong.
Write a polite but firm letter to a landlord asking for a broken heater to be repaired before winter.
